method: APNIC publishes the registry's own delegation records, so the address ranges allocated to CN are authoritative rather than inferred. A root is mainland-hosted when every A record resolved for it falls inside those ranges. These are the verdicts behind the china-web and china-direct-curated rules, produced by scripts/mainland_hosting_probe.py across the rounds named in probe_round. The ecs-2026-09-19 round names a mainland client subnet in the query, so the answer is the one a mainland client receives rather than the one this probe's own location earns; resolved_via records the host answered for when a root's own apex does not resolve.
